label: GENUS_1: IsGenus g: g is a predicable said of its species in what they are and divided into them by…
definition: `IsGenus g` (parameter of the Metaphysics III.3 readings): g is a predicable said of its species in what they are (in quid) and divided into them by differentiae of which it is not itself said. Being is not a genus in this sense (STMT-BEING-NOT-A-GENUS).
note: Typed parameter location: IsGenus : Term → Prop in BeingIsNotAGenusReading. The linked declaration says ¬ IsGenus being for the supplied being : Term; it is a constraining premise, not a definition of the primitive IsGenus predicate. Applicability of the predicable/differentia gloss to supplied terms remains OPEN.
